textAlternative.es: Mago del Eco, mago de bigote y rizos con mechon blanco, abrigo ciruela y verde azulado, aro de madera y varita.
textAlternative.en: Echo Mage, a mustached mage with a white curl lock, plum and teal coat, wooden ring and wand.

review: Inspected original and prepared image. Medium-brown adult male with short curls, white front lock, neat mustache/clean chin, attentive listening expression. Plum/teal wave brooch, plain wooden resonator ring and short willow wand distinguish identity. Whole feet and natural hands, empty ring center, no lettering/sound waves. Static art does not add audio/mechanics. Teatro coherence. Integration and actual miniature readability remain to be verified.
